paper_metadata.title: Enhancing Knapsack-Based Financial Portfolio Optimization Using Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm

summary: This IEEE Access item is a correction notice to the 2024 paper 'Enhancing Knapsack-Based Financial Portfolio Optimization Using QAOA'. It adds a missing reference (Holst 2023) and clarifies that parts of the feasibility oracle and mixer construction were informed by that work. The correction contains no experimental results, resource counts, or quantitative performance data.

experiments.description: Correction notice for a prior paper on QAOA-based knapsack/portfolio optimization; no new experiment details are reported in this correction text.

algorithm.variant: QAOA for knapsack-based financial portfolio optimization

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Portfolio selection reformulated as a knapsack problem with binary decision variables; exact qubit-to-variable mapping not reported in this correction notice.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Maximize portfolio return under knapsack-style investment constraints (as described in the referenced original paper).
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Feasibility oracle and mixer structure used within QAOA; exact penalty/constraint details not reported here.

problem_instance.description: Financial portfolio optimization instance(s) from the referenced original article; this correction notice does not provide the concrete instance details.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: The correction notice states that the original study evaluated the method using both simulated and real quantum devices, but no experimental protocol details are given here.
